      FreeStyle High-Protein Kibble Lamb & Chickpeas Recipe

      Loading...
      Rich, hearty lamb meets powerful protein-packed nutrition. With 81% animal-based protein from lamb, turkey, and salmon, this grain-free recipe delivers the amino acids active dogs need to build lean muscle and recover after every adventure. Real lamb provides natural zinc and iron that support immune health, while chickpeas offer fiber-rich, sustained energy without grains, white potatoes, or tapioca. It's the complete nutrition your athlete deserves.
      Available in
      ,
      ,
      ,

      Retailer’s stock may vary, contact retailer for their inventory

      • Grain-Free

        Without white potatoes or tapioca.

        Advanced Probiotics

        GanedenBC30® probiotic supports your pet’s digestive and immune health.

        No Egg or Chicken Proteins

        Not all dogs like chicken and eggs, which are commonly reported allergens. That’s why we’ve developed recipes using alternative protein sources.

        Zinc & Iron from Real Lamb

        The combination of Zinc and Iron from real lamb helps support your dog’s overall immune health.

        Lower in Carbs

        Low carbohydrate levels and low glycemic ingredients.

        Lean Muscles & Healthy Heart

        Animal-based protein sources contain amino acids that work together to support lean muscle mass and a healthy heart.

        Brilliant Skin & Coat

        A balanced amount of Omega-3 and Omega-6 fatty acids nourish your pet’s skin and help promote a beautiful shiny coat.

      • Deboned Lamb, Turkey Meal, Salmon Meal, Whole Peas, Sweet Potato, Chickpeas, Chicken Fat (preserved with Mixed Tocopherols & Citric Acid), Lamb Meal, Pea Fiber, Natural Flavor, Dried Tomatoes, Yeast Culture, Salt, Potassium Chloride, DL-Methionine, Choline Chloride, Dried Chicory Root, Taurine, Vitamin E Supplement, Dried Apples, Dried Blueberries, Dried Carrots, Zinc Proteinate, L-Ascorbyl-2-Polyphosphate (source of Vitamin C), Zinc Sulfate, Iron Proteinate, Niacin Supplement, Iron Sulfate, Copper Proteinate, Vitamin A Supplement, Copper Sulfate, Thiamine Mononitrate, Manganese Proteinate, d-Calcium Pantothenate, Riboflavin Supplement, Dried Bacillus coagulans Fermentation Product, Pyridoxine Hydrochloride, Biotin, Manganous Oxide, Vitamin B12 Supplement, Vitamin D3 Supplement, Ethylenediamine Dihydroiodide, Folic Acid, Sodium Selenite, Calcium Iodate, Rosemary Extract.

        nutrition statement

        Nulo FreeStyle Adult Lamb & Chickpeas Recipe is formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for maintenance.

      • Every dog is a little different, so the ideal feeding amount may vary with age, neuter status, environment, and activity level. Use the feeding information as a starting guideline and adjust as required to maintain optimal body weight. Ask your veterinarian if you’re unsure. Always provide plenty of clean, fresh water and hugs. Adult Dog Daily Feeding Guidelines (cups/day, 8 oz measuring cup) Up to 15 lbs: ½ - 1 cup 16 - 25 lbs: 1 – 1½ cups 26 - 40 lbs: 1½ - 2¼ cups 41 - 60 lbs: 2¼ - 3 cups 61 - 80 lbs: 3 – 3¾ cups 81 - 100 lbs: 3¾ - 4½ cups Over 100 lbs: 4½ cups + ½ for each additional 20 lbs This food provides complete and balanced nutrition for the maintenance of adult dogs. This formula is not intended as the sole diet for growing puppies, pregnant or lactating dogs – as they have special nutritional needs that require a different balance of protein, calories and other nutrients.

        the nulo guarantee

        If you or your pet are not completely satisfied with your Nulo purchase, our Nulo Guarantee allows you to return any remaining portion of the product in its original packaging to your retailer with a receipt for a full refund or an exchange.

        feeding guidelines

        high protein kibble lamb chickpeas recipe table
        Weight (lbs) Feed Adult Daily
        Up to 15 lbs ½ - 1 cup
        16 - 25 lbs 1 - 1½ cups
        26 - 40 lbs 1½ - 2¼ cups
        41 - 60 lbs 2¼ - 3 cups
        61 - 80 lbs 3 - 3¾ cups
        81 - 100 lbs 3¾ - 4½ cups
        Over 100 lbs @4½ cups + ½ for each additional 20 lbs

      • Nulo Freestyle offers a wide range of dry, wet, freeze-dried raw, treat, and topper recipes to fuel your dog’s adventures. On average, 80-87% of the protein in our Freestyle diets for dogs comes from animal sources, which provides your dog with the ideal amino acid profile! Freestyle’s formulas are grain-free, using ingredients like sweet potatoes and chickpeas as low-glycemic, whole-food carbohydrate sources. Find Nulo Freestyle at your local independent pet specialty retailer or through select online retailers.
